_about: Majors per game (docs/design-tool.md, display rules 5 and 6). Read by lib/view/majors.js. Each game is keyed by its start.gg videogame id; 'default' applies to any game without its own list. An entry is a column: label (the column header), pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression tested against the tournament name) and kind ('known' for the known majors, 'game' for a major specific to this game). A tournament counts only where the seeded game had a main event there: its largest bracket of that game at that tournament whose tournament or event name matches none of 'exclude'. One result per year per column (the year's largest such event).

default.name: any game without its own list
